name: Lantern Man
role: Gives the Lantern Men's work in person
about: Protection racketeers and arsonists: courteous as undertakers, fond of fire.

say: Dark nights out here. A man ought to have a light.
We've nothing to say to you.
We'd like to see it finished.
A gentleman has declined to pay us.
There's a wagon that's not paid its dues.
Bring it round to us, quiet as you like.
